expectedResult: The valid component/category mapping is derived by the backend and matching assignment candidates can be loaded.
actualResult: After selecting IDTS Bug Report and SAP CAP Backend, Smart Assign loaded matching Developers; SangVN was selected and persisted on Assigned BUG-0026 after refresh.

evidence.description: Assigned BUG-0026 after refresh proves the valid mapping supported candidate loading and assignment.

privacyReview.notes: The Smart Assign dialog containing developer emails was deliberately not captured; the sanitized assigned Object Page is retained.

limitations: Candidate loading was verified interactively; email-bearing Smart Assign evidence was excluded for privacy.
